signature: Publisher documents unsigned binaries; SHA256 values are GitHub release asset digests, not a signature or malware verdict.
telemetry: Mandatory machine identifier, package identifiers, latency/errors and GitHub organization. Use explicitly for public dependencies; do not wrap private projects automatically.
ca_source: Reviewed incident-patched Homebrew ca-certificates 2026-10-20 public PEM; use /opt/homebrew/etc/ca-certificates/cert.pem or /usr/local/etc/ca-certificates/cert.pem
embedded_runtime: Node 24.21.0; bundled roots include incident-excluded emSign ECC G3. Guarded launcher disables bundled trust and uses the pinned clean PEM snapshot.
